A1.justification: Both PDFs describe Model-Dowser and contain complete, readable 24-page documents, including Appendices A–H. Text extraction and rendered-page comparison support a reliable comparison of the text, equations, tables, and figures.

before.justification: v1 reports original experiments on LLaVA and NVILA, including benchmark comparisons, sensitivity analyses, probing-stability measurements, and continual-learning results in Appendix H.

after.justification: v3 retains these original empirical studies and reports revised NVILA IconQA results in Table 1.

M1.justification: Section 3 retains the same synthetic probing, sensitivity-based importance scoring, parameter masking, and sparse fine-tuning procedure. The practical surrogate in Appendix D is also unchanged.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate COCO-Caption, ImageNet-R, Flickr30k, and IconQA, the same upstream benchmarks, and the five-domain continual-learning scenario in Appendix H. IconQA was already covered in v1; its revised scores do not add coverage.

E2.justification: Corresponding comparisons retain Zeroshot, Full-FT, Grafting, DARE, ModelTailor, and SPIDER. Random selection and MoeLORA also remain in their respective supplementary comparisons.

E3.justification: The stated models, sampling, training budgets, metrics, and depth/update-ratio settings are unchanged. Table 1 still specifies NVILA-Lite-2B with the last 20 decoder layers fine-tuned at an update ratio of 0.1; the numerical revisions do not establish a protocol change or rerun.

E4.justification: The fine-tuning-depth and update-ratio analyses, random-selection comparisons, and synthetic-versus-real probing-stability analyses are unchanged, including Figures 3–8 and the associated appendix evidence.

E5.justification: Both versions retain three-seed standard deviations for random-selection comparisons, five-run statistics in Table 8, and the same significance tests. No uncertainty reporting is added to the revised IconQA results.

E6.justification: Table 1 substantially revises the NVILA IconQA comparison across all seven rows. Model-Dowser's downstream score changes from 135.5 to 92.0 and its H-score from 85.7 to 76.0. Tailor's H-score changes from 44.7 to 71.5, while SPIDER's changes from 78.3 to 56.2, reversing their ranking. Dowser retains the best Avg and H-score but loses its reported downstream-score lead. Other result blocks and appendix results are unchanged.

T1.justification: Theorem 3.1, Corollary 3.2, their proofs, and the surrogate-estimator derivation in Appendices B–D are unchanged. The metric definitions are also retained.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction contributions, and conclusion retain the same claims about forgetting under deeper fine-tuning, data-free importance estimation, computational efficiency, and superior forgetting mitigation.

C2.justification: The explanations of functional sensitivity, early-layer vulnerability, memory efficiency, and robustness are unchanged, as are the appendix interpretations and applicability discussion. No new interpretation accompanies the revised IconQA comparison.

D1.justification: Hardware, batch size, learning rate, probe counts, and implementation links are unchanged. The training-setting sentences moving from page 7 to page 6 were already disclosed in v1.

R1.justification: The references and research positioning in Section 2 and Appendices A and H are unchanged; no cited works or substantive comparisons with prior research are added or removed.

P1.justification: v3 corrects the affiliation spelling from Daejoen to Daejeon and updates the preprint date and version stamp. The scientific prose and section organization remain unchanged.

P2.justification: v3 changes cell emphasis in the IconQA block, removes a stray 'e' row beneath Table 2, and slightly reflows text on pages 6–7. Figure designs, table organization, and appendix layouts are otherwise unchanged.

improvement.justification: The revised IconQA block removes impossible exact-match accuracy values above 100 and restores consistency with the stated aggregation formulas and the unchanged depth plot in Appendix F, Figure 6(b). This improves the credibility of one benchmark comparison, although the PDFs do not explain the correction's provenance. The broader method, theory, and empirical evidence remain unchanged.
